markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (77%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
Invasive risk is 0% with clear margins [F7], but Benign vs Normal is unseparated on frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 77%, Normal 23%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Zero invasive risk; benign favored |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (90% target, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 8% OOD (12/12 regions, stain 3) [F6] | Passes QC despite stain shift |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign, 4/5 Normal (96% top match) [F5] | Nearest neighbors favor Normal tissue |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.74), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Below-typical score; descriptive only (8/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.47); caption-inconsistent (18/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197 excludes 0); all region risks here are 0%.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is normal parenchyma, matching 4/5 nearest neighbors (93%–96% similarity) and the unseparated Normal conformal class (23%).
- Severity-3 frozen-section stain degradation masks atypia, with cell segmentation disabled and 70% reliability error AUROC.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Verify normal lobules versus benign lesion, as the normal-lobules concept is unreliable (0/20).
2. **Regions 2, 5, 6**: Inspect tubules and region 6 ducts/lymphocytes to separate benign lesion from normal tissue.
3. **Regions 3, 11**: Check validated stromal invasion scores (0.91, 0.73) separating this case from Normal match BACH_0308.
